title: Emerald Horizon
meta_description: Emerald Horizon is a beachfront Panama City Beach condo with Gulf views, private balcony, and steps-to-sand access.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Emerald Horizon, a beachfront condo on the 18th floor where open skies, emerald waters, and effortless comfort come together along one of Panama City Beach's most sought-after stretches of sand. With uninterrupted ocean views and a private balcony overlooking the Gulf, this home invites you to slow down, breathe in the sea air, and settle into coastal living at its best.

Inside, the space opens up into a bright, open-concept layout designed for both connection and relaxation. Floor-to-ceiling windows draw the ocean into the living area, creating a constant backdrop of blue whether you're lounging on the sofa, sharing meals, or simply watching the waves roll in. The fully equipped kitchen includes all the essentials for easy at-home dining, while the dining table comfortably seats six for relaxed breakfasts, sunset dinners, or late-night conversations after a day at the beach. A washer and dryer add everyday convenience, making longer stays feel seamless.

Emerald Horizon comfortably sleeps up to eight guests across three private bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom for added privacy and ease. Two of the bedrooms feature king beds, while the third offers a queen, creating a flexible setup ideal for families or groups traveling together. The living room includes a queen sleep sofa, providing additional space without sacrificing comfort.

Step outside onto the balcony to start your mornings with coffee and ocean breezes or end the day watching the sky shift from blue to gold as the sun sets over the Gulf. The beach is just steps away, making spontaneous swims, sunset walks, and long afternoons on the sand part of your daily rhythm.

Located along Thomas Drive, this home places you close to the heart of Panama City Beach while still offering a relaxed, residential feel. You're just minutes from Pier Park's shopping, dining, and entertainment, plus walkable, family-friendly favorites like 810 Bowling, Billiards \& Arcade, WonderWorks, and Pineapple Willy's. Nearby marinas, dolphin tours, beach bars, and kid-approved attractions make it easy to balance adventure with downtime. Whether you're here to explore, unwind, or do a little of both, Emerald Horizon offers the perfect home base for experiencing the Emerald Coast from the front row.

From sunlit mornings to ocean-view evenings, this is a stay defined by space, comfort, and the endless horizon beyond the balcony.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

Panama City Beach delivers a classic Gulf Coast escape with a laid-back, sun-soaked energy that keeps guests coming back year after year. Known for its sugar-white sand and clear emerald waters, this beachfront destination blends easygoing coastal living with plenty of ways to stay entertained---from waterfront dining and family-friendly attractions to vibrant nightlife and outdoor adventures. Days are naturally spent on the beach, boating, or exploring the shoreline, while evenings invite sunset strolls, fresh seafood, and casual fun just minutes from the sand. It's a market that appeals effortlessly to families, couples, and groups looking for a seamless mix of relaxation and activity in a warm, welcoming setting.

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Pier Park, Russell-Fields Pier, Gulf World Marine Park, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Shell Island, Conservation Park, Ripley's Believe It or Not!, ZooWorld Zoological Park---plus 810 Bowling, Billiards \& Arcade, WonderWorks, and Pineapple Willy's all within easy walking distance.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Parking Pass \& Wristband Fee: A one-time $113.40 HOA fee is paid separately via their online portal (link emailed after registration). Pre-register with your name, email, phone, and stay dates. Pick up 1 parking pass and 6 wristbands at check-in.
- On-site parking for 2 cars max
- There is 1 deeded parking space on the 9th floor. Rentals can also request 1 spot from HOA but it is not a set space - choose from any open \& marked in yellow in the parking deck.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)

all: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
